show.description: A passionate artist, Needhi, and billionaire Nishchay — once lovers separated by deceit — reunite years later when fate brings them face to face through art. Hidden truths, betrayal, and redemption unfold as they discover their lost daughter and confront their manipulative past. The story ends with forgiveness, justice, and the family finally finding peace and love again. Watch now.
